records.name: Saarland
records.summary:
The surviving sources for Saarland are framework-level: the July 2026 prison-placement case (a prisoner whose legal gender had been changed under the federal Self-Determination Act sent to a men's prison) that made Land placement rules a live federal debate, and a March 2026 constitutional-law survey of the 2023-26 reform wave — which names other Länder's new placement statutes, Saarland's not among them.

No Saarland-specific trans statute, ordinance, enforcement series or event-security finding survives in the record; prison administration being a Land competence and equality-criminal law federal, visitor exposure tracks the national position.

records.name: Schleswig-Holstein
records.summary:
The surviving sources for Schleswig-Holstein are framework-level: the July 2026 prison-placement case (a prisoner whose legal gender had been changed under the federal Self-Determination Act sent to a men's prison) that turned Land placement law into a federal reform fight, and a March 2026 constitutional-law survey of the 2023-26 Land reform wave, whose named statutes belong to other Länder.

No Schleswig-Holstein trans statute, ordinance, enforcement series or event-security finding survives in the record; prison administration is a Land competence and visitor exposure tracks the national position.
